info.name: WMS Platform — API Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive test collection for all WMS platform APIs (155 requests across 17 sections).

Run requests in order — each flow builds on the previous one.

Setup: Start all infrastructure (docker-compose up), then start all services.
Required services: eureka-server, config-server, identity-service, inventory-service, reservation-service, delivery-service, platform-service, api-gateway.

Sections:
1-7: Identity service (auth, users, owners, staff, agents, customers)
8-11: Inventory service (warehouses, zones, rooms, categories)
12-13: Reservation service (bookings, invoices, payments, cancellation)
14: Goods module (import, approve/reject, receipts, discrepancy)
15: Delivery service (create request, pick items, notify agents, claim, checkpoints, tracking)
16: Internal cross-service endpoints
17: Health checks for all services
